text:
amelia.sales: Heads-up — new POC with BetaRetail. They've connected Okta SCIM and SAML but users aren't provisioning into the POC tenant (beta-retail-1). Okta shows SCIM push status 204. UI shows zero users. Also SAML assertions seem to have NameID set to 'transient' by default. cc @marco.eng @dana.se
marco.eng: 204 from Okta just means Okta got a 2xx from our endpoint. It could still be a 2xx with an error payload or we may be returning 409/403 for subsequent operations. Can you paste the SCIM request headers or logs?
amelia.sales: their admin sent a screenshot of the SCIM mapping and a log snippet: request to /scim/v2/Users responded 204, but our internal logs show a 409 duplicate error for externalId shortly after. They also included the SAML sample: NameID Format=urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient, NameID=_abc123

dana.se: two likely problems: 1) NameID transient isn't usable for email-based login or mapping; we expect NameID=email or at least include an email attribute. 2) duplicate externalId -> Okta may be pushing the same externalId for multiple members of a group push if they misconfigured the userName/externalId mapping. For SCIM we look for 'userName' (or 'externalId') to be stable.
amelia.sales: they used 'user.id' as externalId in the mapping. Okta admin says group push flattens and sometimes sends the same id for group members.
marco.eng: that explains the 409. Our SCIM implementation treats externalId as a unique id for dedupe. If Okta is sending a non-unique value we reject with 409 => Okta still shows 2xx. Two fixes: change Okta SCIM user mapping to use 'user.login' or 'user.email' for externalId/userName OR enable 'create users if not exist' mapping with proper expression. Sample mapping we recommend in Okta app settings:
```json
{
  "userName": "user.login",
  "externalId": "user.login",
  "emails": ["user.email"]
}
```

claire.sec: security note: for Dedicated/private trials also verify that their outbound NAT IPs aren't getting rewritten by CASB/proxy. If headers are stripped or a proxy terminates TLS and reissues requests without original Authorization header we will see 401/403. For BetaRetail we require a signed SCIM token; please confirm they haven't pasted the hosted API key into the Bearer header.
amelia.sales: they admitted they copied the hosted onboarding key. They assumed it worked for SCIM. Can we issue a scoped, temporary SCIM token and a separate short-lived inference key for dedicated throughput tests? They need to run a 1-hour sustained load to validate throughput.
ops-bot: existing policy allows creation of scoped temporary creds for trials after SOC review. Requesting ops approval.
dana.se: we can create two tokens: scim_service_XXXX (scoped to /scim only) and tmp_dedicated_key_YYYY (scoped to inference:run,dedicated:test) expiring in 36h. Note: tmp_dedicated_key will be restricted to the test pool name 'dedicated-beta-1' and model 'benchmark-lite'. Will that cover it?
amelia.sales: yes please. Also can we give them Okta SAML mapping guidance to set NameID to EmailAddress and add an attribute mapping for groups -> 'teams' so our group sync picks up roles?
marco.eng: here's a minimal SAML assertion example we can share with their Okta admin to fix NameID and groups mapping:
```xml
<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:emailAddress\">user@example.com</saml:NameID>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:AttributeStatement>
    <saml:Attribute Name=\"email\"><saml:AttributeValue>user@example.com</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
    <saml:Attribute Name=\"groups\"><saml:AttributeValue>beta-eng</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
  </saml:AttributeStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```

marco.eng: and ask them to run this curl from inside their network to validate SCIM auth once we hand over the scim token:
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer SCIM_SERVICE_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/scim+json\" \
  https://scim.redwood-inference.example.com/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
```

claire.sec: also remind them not to share the tokens in screenshots. We'll DM the secrets to the named POC contact only. For Private customers we might need mTLS; BetaRetail is hosted trial so bearer token is fine but restricted to IP ranges if they request.
amelia.sales: ok i'll collect screenshots and confirm they update the mapping. @dana.se please create the two temp tokens and DM me the secrets. I'll patch the SCIM mapping doc into the support ticket and ask Okta admin to re-run group push.
dana.se: created tokens: scim_service_r8f3 (expires=1768167056), tmp_dedicated_r8f3 (expires=1768167056, scopes=[inference:run,dedicated:test], pool=dedicated-beta-1). DMing secrets to Amelia now.
amelia.sales: received, sent to BetaRetail admin with the SAML + SCIM mapping steps. i asked them to perform a manual group push and to paste logs if it still shows 204 but users don't appear. will update thread when they confirm. thanks team :pray:
